scope: Primary abstract-level context only; the algebraic proof here is self-contained.

sources.title: Does stability of relativistic dissipative fluid dynamics imply causality?
sources.authors: Shi Pu, Tomoi Koide, Dirk H. Rischke
sources.statement: Their specified dissipative-fluid model is analysed in the rest and Lorentz-boosted frames, with a causality condition relevant to boosted stability. Their model is not substituted for ours.

sources.title: Is Relativistic Hydrodynamics always Symmetric-Hyperbolic in the Linear Regime?
sources.statement: Connects Onsager-Casimir symmetry with symmetric hyperbolicity near equilibrium. No equilibrium premise from that abstract is imposed on our declared nonzero-heat frozen model.
